lines.text: The LORD appointed a great fish to swallow Jonah, and he spent three days and three nights in its belly.
From inside the fish, Jonah prayed to the LORD his God and said the LORD heard his voice.
Jonah said the LORD cast him into the deep, and that he would look once more toward God's holy temple.
Jonah said the waters engulfed him, the seaweed wrapped around his feet, and the LORD raised his life from the pit.
Jonah vowed to sacrifice with the voice of mourning, and the LORD commanded the fish to vomit him onto dry land.
